newsitem.title: USA: Centura results hurt by distribution.
newsitem.headline: Centura results hurt by distribution.

text.p: Centura Software Corp on Friday called its first-quarter results disappointing and blamed distribution problems in Asia and South America.
Centura reported a first-quarter loss of $0.14 per share, compared with a profit of $0.03 for the same period a year ago.
Centura said its new ForeSite web integration server is doing well, and it will continue its marketing efforts to boost this and other new products.
"We are clearly disappointed that our financial results for the quarter interrupted the profitable trend established at the beginning of 1996," company President Sam Inman said in a statement.

"While our core products fared well in a number of geographies, channel issues, specifically Asia and South America, are responsible for the majority of our revenue decline from last year," he added. "We have taken steps to improve our distribution channels in these markets and are adding resources where required."
Centura shares were down 1/2 to 2-3/4 in early trading on Friday.
